description: Which stage produced this record: 1 cypher, 2 caption LLM, 3 FLUX. One line per hop, in order.
Human name for the hop: cypher | caption | flux.
THE OUTPUT of this hop - the fact text, the caption, or the PNG path. This is the column to read when tracing what the data actually looked like.
What this hop received. Absent on hop 1, whose input is the cypher query itself.
Model that produced the value. Recorded because it is an experiment variable - a trace is only meaningful if you know which model made it.
Hop 1 only. The exact query run, so the trace is reproducible.
Hop 1 only. Which graph was read.
Hop 1 only. How many facts the query matched before selection.
Hop 1 only. Which fact of the result set was traced.
Hop 1 only. When the fact became true.
Hop 1 only. When it was SUPERSEDED. Non-null means the conversation later overturned it - the most interesting facts to draw.
Wall time for this hop. The reason the trace exists as much as the strings are.
Hop 3 only. Size of the PNG produced.
